digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, create, transition, claim, etc.)
propositions: Mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, archive, transition, claim, reopen) currently print nothing on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from writes and causing agents to run redundant verification queries.

A uniform confirmation contract must be implemented: success prints `<past-tense-verb> <args-summary>` (e.g. `linked src -> target`), no-ops print `no change: <reason>`, and already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, transition) are normalized to the same format without information loss.

Global output flags `--quiet` and `--output json` must be pre-extracted at the top-level router before verb dispatch to uniformly cover all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with `--quiet` suppressing text confirmations only and `--output json` emitting a structured envelope.

Consumed seam returns (e.g. add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT record) must remain unchanged; confirmations are added only via parallel channels or derived from existing seam signals without altering return types.

link's REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical before and after, printed once per invocation in text mode without an extra confirmation line; under `--output json` the record nests as an envelope field.
Confirmations must print to stdout only (logs to stderr), with no redundant store reads used to build confirmation messages—each line derives only from CLI args and the seam's direct outcome.
